subject: Infra handshake + service onboarding cadence (credentials & evidence)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@keycare.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@keycare.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Infra handshake + service onboarding cadence (credentials & evidence)

Hi Mina / Ben —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. KeyCare's infra team is ready to start the private deployment intake and we wanted to capture the minimal set of items to unblock account provisioning and first-day smoke traffic. Our suggested timeline is ~3 weeks for provisioning + connectivity run, with day-0 ops handoff following.

We need visibility on the following from Redwood before we schedule the kickoff call:

- Dedicated service accounts & principal names you want us to use (preferred: service/redwood-keycare)
- IP ranges for outbound allowlist (we will put Azure NSG rules in place)
- TLS / mTLS cert fingerprint guidance and any required CN / SAN expectations
- KMS/HSM integration options for customer-managed keys (we are required to use our KMS for audit logs)
- Required SOC2/pen-test evidence items for procurement (procurement@keycare.com is cc'd)
- Any recommended network topology for split-homed peering vs. transit (we attached our current topology)

Attachments: keycare-topology-v1.pdf (diagram)

Can you confirm who on your side owns: (a) network allowlist, (b) service account creation, (c) initial smoke credentials? Also propose 30 min for an intake sync this week.

Elena
Elena Morales
Sr. Cloud Eng, KeyCare Health
elena@keycare.com
[Attachment: keycare-topology-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@keycare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Infra handshake + service onboarding cadence (credentials & evidence)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the diagram and the clear list. Short answers up front so you can proceed:

- Redwood will provide the service account naming recommendation and a short RBAC template; operations will create the service principal for hosted-private connectors unless you prefer to create and grant us access.
- IP allowlist: we have a small pool of egress IPs for customer-dedicated traffic. I will share the set in a follow-up (target EOD).
- TLS: we support both server-side TLS with customer certs and mutual TLS for control plane calls. For mTLS we'll need the client cert CN and a sample cert during initial auth testing.
- KMS: we support KMS integrations; for private deployments there are two profiles: (a) Redwood-managed envelope keys with customer CMK wrapping, or (b) fully customer-managed KMS (VPC peered KMS). We should confirm which model KeyCare requires.
- SOC2 evidence: Ben will pull the standard evidence bundle (SOC2 report excerpt, pen test summary, data retention/KMS policy) and share a redacted set.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 30 min intake call — propose Mon 8/10 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 8/11 09:00-09:30 PT.
2) We will provide: service-account naming doc + RBAC template, egress IP list, and a short onboarding checklist (day-0 smoke tests).
3) You share: KMS preference, certs/mTLS expectations, procurement items for the MOU.

Kimberly, Ben — can you confirm availability for the proposed slots and whether we should create a shared Drive folder for evidence exchange?

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 0132

Hey all —

I can take point on the evidence bundle and the RBAC template. Quick checklist (internal runbook style) I'll produce and share in the Drive:

- RBAC template (IAM roles + least privilege bindings) — action: Ben (draft by 8/10)
- Egress IP set for tenant-dedicated flows — action: Mina (publishes EOD 8/7)
- mTLS test cert & sample curl sequence for control-plane calls — action: Kimberly (will prep)
- SOC2 redacted pack + pen-test summary — action: Ben (deliver 8/9)
- Day-0 smoke tests (health, perf baseline, KV cache sanity) + acceptance criteria — action: Mina/Eng (draft)
- MOU / procurement kickoff — action: Procurement@redwood (I will loop in and share DocuSign link)

I agree a 30-min intake is sufficient. I can do Mon 8/10 10:00 PT. If that works for KeyCare let's lock it and I'll create a calendar invite and a Drive folder (restricted to participants) and post the onboarding checklist there.

Ben
